title: Text: DET Ben Fidelman ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Will there be another call after?
There hasn’t been one in recent years and we’re not planning on one today
Let me know if you have specific questions or requests
I mean I’ll take Pleis to talk about the picks, if possible. Won’t take long.
Next time he’ll be available will be this weekend when he makes the rounds in Detroit per usual. Everyone is scrambling to prepare for tomorrow right now, so can’t talk tonight.
